# Laotian Times

> > Laotian Times is a news platform covering regional politics, economy, infrastructure, and diplomatic developments across Laos and Southeast Asia.

Laotian Times provides comprehensive coverage of Laos' political landscape, economic initiatives, and regional relationships with neighboring countries like Thailand and Vietnam. The site also features employment opportunities and cultural stories highlighting developments in tourism, education, and social initiatives.

## Key Topics

- Laos
- Thailand
- Vietnam
- Fuel Crisis
- Regional Politics
- Diplomatic News
- Infrastructure Development
- Tourism Industry
- International Cooperation
- Thai-Laos Relations
- Vietnam-Laos Relations
- Economy
- Women Empowerment
- Regional Trade
- Vientiane

- [Thai PM Anutin Reassures Laos of Continued Fuel Supply Amid 25 Percent Cut](https://laotiantimes.com/2026/03/21/thai-pm-anutin-reassures-laos-of-continued-fuel-supply-amid-25-percent-cut): Thai PM Anutin reassures Laos on fuel supply despite 25% export reduction
- [Vietnam Steps In to Supply Laos With 50 Million Litres of Fuel Amid Crisis](https://laotiantimes.com/2026/03/21/vietnam-steps-in-to-supply-laos-with-50-million-litres-of-fuel-amid-crisis): Vietnam supplies 50M litres of fuel to Laos amid Thailand export cut crisis
